uses.n: Invasion of Alara // Awaken the Maelstrom

111-4881-6909.manaNeeded: {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
111-4881-6909.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Alara.
111-4881-6909.description:
Defeat Invasion of Alara, causing you to then cast Awaken the Maelstrom without paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

2092-2972-8167.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 7 or greater.
2092-2972-8167.description:
Activate Kiora by paying {1} due to Agatha, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token with flying.
When the Dragon enters, Ganax triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

6575-6774-7704--85.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield with four lore counters on it due to Loading Zone and Doc Samson, its fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2169-3967--5.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2.

944-1718-6072-7182.description:
Cast Graveshifter for its evoke cost by paying {2} due to Planar Gate.
When Graveshifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Catalyst Elemental from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Graveshifter.
When Graveshifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Graveshifter with haste.
When the Graveshifter token enters, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Catalyst Elemental by paying {R} due to Planar Gate.
Activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Catalyst Elemental dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Catalyst Elemental with haste.
Activate the Catalyst Elemental token by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
944-1718-6072-7182.notes: If you have at least {2}{R} in your mana pool on a particular iteration, step 10 can be skipped.

1170-1171-7175.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
1170-1171-7175.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

413-2533-4681-6913.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Chameleon enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Loyal Retainers enters, Blasting Station triggers. Resolve both triggers from this step and step 2, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Chameleon.
Repeat.

1510-4574-5849-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its modular ability triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Arcbound Stinger from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

2341-2495-5034.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Sol Ring and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Sol Ring and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Sol Ring and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

4195-4211-4316-4574.description:
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2232-2511-2792-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2232-2511-2792-6843.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Great Whale.
Repeat.

224-3147-3314-3430-6664.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using three in any combination of {W} and/or {U}, and have the mana to cast it.
224-3147-3314-3430-6664.description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from your hand to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Chulane.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3499-4053-5499--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
3499-4053-5499--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

1339-2558-5315-6666.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2558-5315-6666.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Insect.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.

2105-3204-4885-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
2105-3204-4885-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

338-2060-6081--60.manaNeeded: {5}{W} plus enougb mana to animate the land (if needed)
338-2060-6081--60.notablePrerequisites: The land has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
338-2060-6081--60.description:
If needed, animate the land, causing it to become a creature.
Cast Light of Promise by paying its mana cost, attaching it to the animated land.
Activate Black Panther by paying {3}, moving all +1/+1 counters from the animated land to Crystalline Crawler, then causing you to gain at least 3 life and draw a card.
The animated land triggers, putting at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 3.
338-2060-6081--60.notes: If the land has four or more +1/+1 counters on it, this combo will net near-infinite +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler and/or another creature of your choosing.

3518-4772-6232.description:
Cast Tamiyo by paying {3}{U}{U}. Tamiyo enters the battlefield with eight loyalty counters on it due to Doubling Season.
Activate Tamiyo's third loyalty ability by removing eight loyalty counters from it, causing you to get its emblem.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
Tamiyo's emblem triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 3.

2239-4872-5626.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} the first turn, with {5}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
2239-4872-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 2 or less.
You have at least {E}.
2239-4872-5626.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 2 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Ardent Elementalist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}, sacrificing Ardent Elementalist, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1244-4231-4770-5542.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with mana value 2 or less.
1244-4231-4770-5542.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Bygone Bishop triggers twice, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and another creature with mana value 2 or less from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana of any color(s).
Cast the other creature by paying its mana cost.
Bygone Bishop triggers twice, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana of any color(s).
Repeat.

803-3197-4304.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Bear" chosen.
803-3197-4304.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Herd Baloth enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Arcane Adaptation, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Arcane Adaptation, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 3.

1339-3265-4772-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3265-4772-4871.description:
Activate Dockside Chef by paying {1}{B} and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Dockside Chef ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

245-744-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
245-744-2034.description:
Activate Pegasus Refuge by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Pegasus creature token.
When the Pegasus enters the battlefield, Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pegasus, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

372-1621-4598.manaNeeded: {4}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-1621-4598.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Wispweaver Angel and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Wispweaver Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Wispweaver Angel's enters-the-battlefield ability.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

6-215-864-2436.notablePrerequisites:
Marwyn does not have summoning sickness.
Marwyn has a power of at least seven.
6-215-864-2436.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Cast Vitalize by paying {G}, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Eternal Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Eternal Witness by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Vitalize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1110-2019-2292-2906.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast The Prismatic Piper for {0} due to Rakdos.
1110-2019-2292-2906.description:
Cast The Prismatic Piper from the command zone by paying {0}.
Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target opponent.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing The Prismatic Piper.
Choose to have The Prismatic Piper return to command zone.
Resolve the Viscera Seer's ability, scrying one.
Repeat.

1657-4050-4535.description:
Sacrifice Murderous Redcap to Phyrexian Altar to add one mana of any color.
Murderous Redcap's persist triggers, returning it to the battlefield.
Murderous Redcap returns to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter which cancel out.
Murderous Redcap triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
